usedFor: Pipedrive and HubSpot are both CRMs, so this pair copies work from one to the other. “New Deal” in Pipedrive can open a “Create Deal” in HubSpot as it happens.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Pipedrive, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It mirrors each Pipedrive deal into HubSpot, and the trigger is pushed, so there is no wait. The other templates start from HubSpot and create a person or update a contact.

watchOut: Going the other way, “When a deal is created or updated” is polling and fires on updates, so one HubSpot deal can run “Create Person” twice. “Update Contact” also needs the contact's email.
